lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the mid-to-posterior flank, transitioning to a dense, random cluster distribution anterior to the gill slits and across the head region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with faint horizontal lines to form a grid; large primary blobs are positioned at the center of these rectangular grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edges to shaded lower edges, extending horizontally from the gill region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a highly dense distribution of small, high-luminance spots that do not follow the grid-like alignment of the lateral flank patterning.
